title: PALMs: Using Multi Construct-Grounded Rationales for Modeling Population Preferences in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Sampling user personas from five different countries (USA, India, Brazil, France, Italy) and comparing the model's aggregate response distributions to ground-truth human survey distributions on cultural norms, values, and morality using datasets like CultureBank, PEW Global Attitudes Survey, and the World Values Survey.

Conditioning models on user personas that include specific demographic attributes (ethnicity, age group, gender, education, and political leaning) to measure how well the model aligns with nuanced, intersectional human preferences instead of defaulting to aggregate majority viewpoints, evaluated via personalized reward modeling (PRISM, PersonalizedRewardBench) and population simulation (SimBench).
